$sources: QCS 2014 (Qatar Construction Specifications): wind loading to BS 6399-2; the basic wind speed of Qatar's sites (SAEngine practice value, VERIFY.md Q1)
source: QCS 2014 refers the wind loading to BS 6399-2: Vb is the basic hourly mean wind speed at 10 m in open country (BS 6399-2 2.2.1). One value for the whole peninsula as SAEngine practice (VERIFY.md Q1: to be replaced by the value the project's authority or the QCS section in force gives). Seismic zone 0: QCS 2014 and the British Standards give no earthquake loading (not covered; zoneCoefficients of bs8110). Elsewhere a custom location.
